name: Cupbop Korean BBQ (Logan, Draper & Orem, UT) "B-Bop" BBQ Beef over Rice & Glass Noodles
whyItWorks: Thinly sliced marinated Korean ribeye beef (bulgogi style) served over steamed white rice and translucent sweet potato glass noodles (japchae). Sweet potato starch noodles are exceptionally gentle on digestion.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the B-Bop explicitly at 'Spice Level 1' (sweet mild soy glaze); request no spicy sauce and hold cabbage slaw.
watchOuts: Specify Spice Level 1 (mild); levels 4-10 contain intense chili oil and ghost pepper
